name: Nightmare Funkin'
summary:
A mod based on 2D platforming brawler video game "Nightmare Cops" developed by Tom Fulp and JohnnyUtah.

This mod might contain flashing lights so beware!!

After a long time cooking in the oven, Nightmare Funkin' is finally here!
A tribute to the hard work of Johnny Utah and the Nightmare Cops development team!

FEATURES:

2 Story Mode Weeks (NIGHTMARE & MISSION 1)
3 Pico Remixes
1 Erect Mix
Tankman
